title: S5 full-bleed-split — two equal fields, media bleeding to the viewport edge
idea: Two fields of equal height divide the band edge to edge. The media half touches the viewport with no gutter and no rounded corner; the copy half is a solid surface, not a card on a background.
why_new: every split on every site renders inside the same content gutters today, so the two halves always read as two boxes on a page. This is the section twin of the split-bleed-duo hero.
built_from: one full-aligned group holding a two-column row with zero gap and no padding on the media column.
risk: when the design direction's Canvas is framed, nothing bleeds and the archetype loses its whole point — it must either be ineligible on a framed canvas or degrade to asymmetric-split honestly. The copy half needs its own contrast check against the surface it paints.
